definitions.explanation: The act of stopping smoking completely. A more emphatic and decisive term than 禁煙, emphasizing the finality of cutting off the habit.

examples.japanese: {断煙|だんえん}を{決意|けつい}した。
{断煙|だんえん}してからもう{三|さん}{年|ねん}になる。
examples.english: It's been three years since I quit smoking.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}のために{断煙|だんえん}を{勧|すす}められたが、なかなか{実行|じっこう}できない。
examples.english: I was advised to quit smoking for my health, but I can't seem to follow through.

notes:
{断|だん} means 'to cut off' or 'to sever,' and {煙|えん} means 'smoke.' {断煙|だんえん} emphasizes the decisive, complete severing of the smoking habit, making it a stronger expression than {禁煙|きんえん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {断煙|だんえん}する (to quit smoking)
- {断煙|だんえん}を{決意|けつい}する (to resolve to quit smoking)
- {断煙|だんえん}に{成功|せいこう}する (to succeed in quitting smoking)
- {断煙|だんえん}{補助|ほじょ} (smoking cessation aid)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {禁煙|きんえん} — no smoking; smoking cessation (the most common word; also used for 'no-smoking' areas)
- {卒煙|そつえん} — graduating from smoking (a more positive, casual way to say one has quit)
- {喫煙|きつえん} — smoking (the opposite; the act of smoking)
